title: Works as Expected
text: Works as Expected. This wine vacuum pump works as expected. It's easy to use and it comes with 3 reusable stoppers which is more than enough for the average person. It does a good job of keeping leftover wine fresh.

product_metadata.title: Airtender Wine Vacuum Pump with 3 Reusable Bottle Stopper Vacuum Seals, for Wine Preservation and Storage
features: MADE IN THE NETHERLANDS - FIVE YEAR WARRANTY: AIRTENDER delivers a vacuum method to keep wine fresh for longer and perfectly on taste. Vacuum seals either cork or screw top wine bottles. Store open bottles leakproof lying under vacuum in wine rack, cooling or climate cabinet.
KEEP FRESH UP TO 5X LONGER : vacuum counteracts the ageing process of wine.
WITH VACUUM INDICATOR: the pump provides a signal at the correct vacuum level. The vacuum stopper has a visible vacuum indicator and fits under the screw cap.

STORE LEAKPROOF: the Nanostopper allows wine bottle screw tops to be firmly in place for 100% leak-proof storage in the refrigerator or horizontally in a wine rack, cooling and/or climate controlled cabinet.
MADE WITH CARE FOR PEOPLE & PLANET: CO2 FRIENDLY produced using sustainable and recyclable materials. Assembled in social workshops.
